declarations.docstring: Equivalence between homomorphisms from a group to a monoid and homomorphisms to its units.
Equivalence from representations to algebra homomorphisms from the monoid algebra into module endomorphisms.
The algebra homomorphism associated with a representation sends a singleton basis element to the corresponding action.
Equivalence from representations to group homomorphisms into linear automorphisms.
The linear automorphism obtained from a representation acts as the original representation.
The representation recovered from a homomorphism to linear automorphisms has its specified action.
